meta.rule: Every value is kept as its source printed it, side by side with every other source for the same measure and year. Values are never averaged, gaps are never filled and a missing value is never written as zero (it is simply absent and listed in the completeness matrix). Values reused from data/counties-cob.json (Kisumu row, FY 2021/22 to FY 2024/25) carry reused_from and must equal that file exactly. Units are KSh million unless the unit field says KSh billion (values reused from history.json in its own unit). Fiscal years run 1 July to 30 June and keep the form FY yyyy/yy. Rates (absorption) are stored only as printed, in per cent. Every value stays "Provisional: awaiting editorial review" until a review record exists; none exists. Kisumu is not yet on pages (lib/county-registry.js NOT_YET_ON_PAGES).
meta.discrepancy_rule: For each measure and year, every pair of values that differ by more than 1 per cent of the smaller value (after converting KSh billion to KSh million) is a discrepancy case, status open. Pairs of budget values whose budget_version is explicitly different (original against supplementary) are not compared: they are expected to differ. Rates are compared the same way and reported in percentage points.
meta.programme: Kisumu Phase 1 data layer (owner decision: Kisumu, code 042, is the next county; 27 Nov 2026); inputs docs/research/kisumu-2026-11-27/

read_methods.text: PDF text layer (pdftotext). For the scanned Controller of Budget reports and Parliament library copies this is the publisher's or library's OCR layer.
read_methods.ocr-tesseract: Page rendered at 300 dpi (greyscale) and read with tesseract 5, page segmentation mode 6, on 27 Nov 2026; the second reading (second_reading) is either the PDF text layer or a second tesseract run at 400 dpi in mode 4.
read_methods.ocr-rapidocr: RapidOCR reading made by an earlier step (values reused from data/counties-cob.json).

meta.confidence_scale: 5 = clean printed table read twice; 4 = clean table or exact printed figure; 3 = rounded narrative figure, or OCR of a scanned page; 2 = chart label or garbled text layer; 1 = not used
not_used: Controller of Budget in-year reports for FY 2025/26 (first quarter; first nine months, Part I): partial-year figures, not comparable with full years; the FY 2025/26 annual report (August 2026) is used instead.

budget_total.label: Budget, total (recurrent + development)
budget_total.definition: Approved county budget for the year. budget_version says which version (original, supplementary, or as reported without a stated version).

budget_recurrent.label: Budget, recurrent
budget_recurrent.definition: Recurrent part of the approved budget.

budget_development.label: Budget, development
budget_development.definition: Development part of the approved budget.

equitable_share_budgeted.label: Equitable share, budgeted or expected
equitable_share_budgeted.definition: Equitable share of revenue raised nationally that the budget expected.

equitable_share_received.label: Equitable share, received
equitable_share_received.definition: Equitable share actually received in the year.

conditional_grants_budgeted.label: Conditional grants or additional allocations, budgeted
conditional_grants_budgeted.definition: Conditional grants or additional allocations (national government and development partners) in the budget.

conditional_grants_received.label: Conditional grants or additional allocations, received
conditional_grants_received.definition: Conditional grants or additional allocations actually received.

osr_total_target.label: Own-source revenue target
osr_total_target.definition: Annual own-source revenue target. basis says whether health facility revenue (FIF/A-i-A) is included.

osr_total_actual.label: Own-source revenue collected, total
osr_total_actual.definition: Own-source revenue collected, including FIF/A-i-A where the source includes it; years before the split was printed carry one figure whose coverage is not stated.

osr_ordinary_actual.label: Own-source revenue collected, ordinary (excluding FIF/A-i-A)
osr_ordinary_actual.definition: Ordinary own-source revenue paid into the County Revenue Fund, excluding health facility revenue and other A-i-A.

osr_fif_aia_actual.label: Own-source revenue collected, FIF or A-i-A
osr_fif_aia_actual.definition: Facility Improvement Financing (health facility revenue) or appropriations-in-aid, as each source labels it.

pending_bills_close.label: Pending bills, stock at 30 June (end of the fiscal year)
pending_bills_close.definition: Stock of unpaid bills at the end of the fiscal year. An opening stock printed in the next year's report is recorded here against the year it closes (stock_point "opening_of_next_year"). From FY 2025/26 the Controller of Budget reports the stock as "trade payables"; basis says so.

wage_bill.label: Wage bill (compensation of employees / personnel emoluments spent)
wage_bill.definition: Actual spending on compensation of employees or personnel emoluments. Some CoB key-issue paragraphs quote a smaller "wage bill" on a basis they do not define; both are kept.

osr_ordinary_target.label: Own-source revenue target, ordinary (excluding FIF/A-i-A)
osr_ordinary_target.definition: Target for ordinary own-source revenue paid into the County Revenue Fund, where the source prints it separately from the FIF/A-i-A target.

osr_fif_aia_target.label: Own-source revenue target, FIF or A-i-A
osr_fif_aia_target.definition: Target for Facility Improvement Financing (health facility revenue) or appropriations-in-aid, as each source labels it.

pending_bills_recurrent_close.label: Pending bills, recurrent part, stock at 30 June
pending_bills_recurrent_close.definition: Recurrent part of the pending-bills stock as printed (scope says whether County Executive only). Never added to the development part to make a total.

pending_bills_development_close.label: Pending bills, development part, stock at 30 June
pending_bills_development_close.definition: Development part of the pending-bills stock as printed. An opening stock printed in the next year's report is recorded against the year it closes (stock_point "opening_of_next_year").

absorption_recurrent_pct.label: Absorption rate, recurrent (as printed)
absorption_recurrent_pct.definition: Recurrent expenditure as a percentage of the recurrent budget, as the source prints it (never recomputed into this series).

absorption_development_pct.label: Absorption rate, development (as printed)
absorption_development_pct.definition: Development expenditure as a percentage of the development budget, as the source prints it.

absorption_total_pct.label: Absorption rate, overall (as printed)
absorption_total_pct.definition: Total expenditure as a percentage of the total budget, as the source prints it.
